events.title: FTSE 100 Mixed As UK Inflation Hits One-Year High At 3.5%
events.description: The FTSE 100 traded mixed Wednesday, gaining 0.05% to 10,738.13, digesting crucial economic data. Energy stocks led thanks to higher oil prices. September consumer price inflation reached 3.5%, the highest since October last year, above the 3.4% forecast.

events.title: CAC 40 Gains 0.58% As EssilorLuxottica Soars On Earnings
events.description: The CAC 40 climbed 0.58% Wednesday as quarterly earnings and political developments drove trading. Brent crude gained 1.7% to $110.75 a barrel, limiting broader market gains.

events.title: Indian Shares End Choppy Session Modestly Lower
events.description: Indian shares swung between gains and losses before closing modestly lower on Wednesday.

events.title: Adidas Profit Outlook Boost Lifts DAX Higher
events.description: Germany's benchmark DAX index advanced 132.51 points or 0.52% Wednesday as investors tracked geopolitical events and corporate earnings. Adidas stock climbed 2.3% after announcing higher FY26 profit expectations following robust quarterly performance.

events.title: Gold Little Changed In Lackluster Trade
events.description: Gold prices held steady on Wednesday amid reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in October and concerns about rising civil unrest in France and Italy.

events.title: Oil Prices Climb As Traders Weigh Middle East Supply Risks
events.description: Oil prices were moving higher on Wednesday as investors weighed conflicting signals on efforts to end the U.S.-Iran war.

events.title: European Shares Mixed As UK Inflation Climbs
events.description: European stocks were mixed on Wednesday as investors digested U.K. inflation data and awaited a raft of earnings for direction.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed; China And Hong Kong Underperform
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Wednesday, with Chinese and Hong Kong markets declining on earnings concerns while markets elsewhere rose following reports of progress towards renewed U.S.-Iran negotiations.

events.title: Pound Rises As Robust U.K. CPI Data Fuels BoE Rate Hike
events.description: The British pound strengthened slightly against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as the U.K. consumer price inflation rose to a one-year high in September on motor fuel prices, fueled expectations on the Bank of England (BoE) rate hike.

events.title: Pound Rises Slightly Against Majors
events.description: The British pound strengthened slightly against other major currencies in the pre-European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises On RBA Hauser Hawkish Remarks
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Wednesday, following warnings from the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser that prompted expectations of another interest rate hike.

events.title: SpaceX Shares Climb As Q3 Turns To Profit On Connectivity, SI Strength
events.description: Shares of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. or SpaceX (SPCX) were gaining around 9% in the overnight activity on the Nasdaq after Elon Musk's spaceflight company reported a significant profit in its third quarter, compared to prior year's loss, as revenues were boosted mainly by Connectivity as well as Super Intelligence or SI operations.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Wednesday.
